answer_1.quote: We apply AutoCompressors to in-context learning (ICL) by compressing up to 90 in-context demonstrations. We consider 11 classification tasks, including 7 SuperGLUE tasks, and we find that summary vectors outperform few-shot ICL with a comparable number of in-context tokens on 8 out of 11 tasks.
answer_1.outputs: Summary vectors and generated text (e.g., class labels in ICL, next tokens in language modeling)

answer_2.quote: We track the perplexity of the final segment when conditioning on the summary vectors for each n. ... For each dataset, we report the mean accuracy and standard deviation ... We measure the quality of the re-ranked results using Recall@20.
